restrictions: Two distinct 64-byte messages M(x), M(y). W0..W7 are the fixed prefix in proof Section 1; W8=y0, W9=y1; W10..W15 add the fixed offsets dbce7a42, aaf3823d, 8d41a28c, 7f214e02, 2423f959, fe640e8c. The target uses the standard IV, exactly 50 steps on both padded blocks, feed-forward, and all 256 output bits.

The walk is g(x)=walkB(state_50(M(x))) XOR q with published q=9360bba83b5873b6d61502d309b821321784a27581a1b17e7fceecc316d76e44. The output registers already hold g. A collision of g implies equal complete digests.

Classical 256-bit word RAM under collision-frontier-v5, reference_operation_cost=3736. The machine has 1024 registers. Body records cost five code bytes and one operation; other instructions cost 36 bytes.
Preprocessing is 462181912017411833 operations and includes the wasm emitter plus the complete 1641-candidate offset and selector search envelopes. preprocessing_log2 rounds upward to 46.81396.
Peak memory is 1048574 bytes; setup peaks at 702512 bytes. Every table and code field fits its declared width.

The normative embedded C source has SHA-256 ac65667aebdd1029a4baaafa025a9cac231826dcaa8f7f2e6531336b564e7210; stripped wasm SHA-256 ecf41d77782c3916c424faf68483335d7337103e5e44b475db3d7399b27ff819; emitted SLP SHA-256 3c909f9a1b73cd35ea6b994b6dc164783ec6643f953a4d6534ef49dd455e1d8b. The organizer executes the packaged Python byte-exact mirror; wasm accounting is participant-run.
For a uniformly random function, the bounded-restart calculation in proof Section 2 gives P_F at least 0.390000001000. H1 is the only score-critical premise and is declared, not proved.

heuristics.statement: The fixed walk succeeds at least as often as the exact bounded attempt against a lazy-sampled uniformly random 256-bit function. Fresh outputs retain collision hazard 2^-256, the first-collision law of a random mapping, independent DP density, and the same hazard after conditioning on the adaptive history.
heuristics.scope: The sha256-r50-prefix-v1 target, the 64-byte message family in proof Section 1, about 2^128 evaluations, and 256 simultaneous trails.
heuristics.extrapolation: The experiments check program correctness at width 16 and full-width projections, and compare fixed width-20 and width-22 projections with shared-function random-mapping ensembles. The fourfold state-space change checks persistence only. Extrapolation to the full attempt is by H1 only.
heuristics.limitations: H1 is a model premise about one fixed function, not a theorem. The experiments do not observe full-width collisions or estimate the claimed probability.
